question: Which of Scoreline payoff, Afterimage payoff, Ward setup priority, package-completion acquisition priority and Faultline rarity causally controls Duskblade package activation, policy sensitivity, RandomBuild movement and reliability under common policies and seeds?
decision: Either select the lexicographically smallest scalar-family cell that reproduces every local and whole-run gate on independent splits, or bound this complete known-level scalar family negatively and move to a structurally different mechanism inside issue #421.
competingOptions: At least one combination of the already-observed discrete levels produces two locally admitted, policy-sensitive Duskblade packages without broad RandomBuild movement or reliability regression.
No combination in the complete known-level scalar family meets those conditions on both independent splits.

methodDecision.reason: The five factors have a complete finite design of 48 cells and the decision requires causal factor isolation. Matched factorial contrasts answer that question directly with fewer assumptions and less compute than an optimiser.
methodDecision.mlDeferredUntil: A selected mechanism passes causal factor identification but fixed sampled policies cannot express a reproducible repertoire.
methodDecision.rlDeferredUntil: A selected mechanism and detector define a policy objective for which optimisation can change the candidate decision.
methodDecision.forbiddenSubstitution: Neither ML nor RL may be used to infer causal factor effects from unmatched candidates or to choose a cell before this factorial's independent validation split.

contentDerivation.base: The frozen V38 high-payoff rare content object.
contentDerivation.scorelineLow: Remove scorelineBonus from normal and upgraded Faultline while retaining Scoreline consumption and Facet completion.
contentDerivation.scorelineHigh: Use 12 normal and 15 upgraded Scoreline bonus damage.
contentDerivation.afterimageLow: Use an explicit reflection multiplier of 2 on normal and upgraded Warden's Edge.
contentDerivation.afterimageHigh: Use a reflection multiplier of 3 on normal and upgraded Warden's Edge.
contentDerivation.rarity: Set only Faultline rarity to uncommon or rare.
contentDerivation.serialization: Canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and one trailing newline; every object is content-addressed before any simulator row.

design.local: Scoreline low/high is crossed under fixed setup 0. Afterimage low/high is crossed with setup 0/1/2. Every cell uses the same 64 sampled policies, seeds, decks, enemies, aspects and four package arms within each split.
design.wholeRun: The complete 2 x 2 x 3 x 2 x 2 design runs under common random numbers. Each cell receives the same four aspect-vow RandomBuild rectangles and the same Duskblade Vow-5 sampled-policy rectangle within a split.
design.liveComparator: RandomBuild comparisons use live content under the same setup and acquisition configuration as the candidate cell.
design.independence: Discovery and validation use disjoint simulation seeds and policy roots. A cell must pass both; no validation result changes a factor level or threshold.
design.causalReadout: For every one-level contrast, per-CRN high-minus-low differences are averaged across matched contexts, clustered by common policy/seed unit and bootstrapped. Scoreline and Afterimage payoff are separate estimands.

localGate.activation: Target-aspect package activation bootstrap lower 95% bound is at least 0.25 SD.
localGate.policyWitnesses: At least eight target-aspect policies activate and consume the named mediator.
localGate.aspectSeparation: Target-minus-other-aspect activation bootstrap lower 95% bound is greater than zero.
localGate.duration: AB-minus-best-single-arm turn delta bootstrap upper 95% bound is at most 0.25 turns.
localGate.admission: A Scoreline payoff or Afterimage-payoff/setup cell is eligible only if every local gate passes on both discovery and validation.

wholeRunGate.randomBuild: For every aspect-vow grid, candidate arm-2 win rate is below 0.50, the paired candidate-minus-live point movement has absolute value at most 0.10, and there is no candidate-added stall or error.
wholeRunGate.policySensitivity: Each Dusk package has at least eight active and eight inactive policy witnesses among the 32 fixed policy indices.
wholeRunGate.functionalSeparation: Each Dusk package has at least two active policy indices not active for the other package.
wholeRunGate.reliability: The policy panel has zero stalls and simulator errors.
wholeRunGate.vow5: The Duskblade Vow-5 policy-panel win rate is at most 0.90.
wholeRunGate.admission: Every whole-run gate passes on both discovery and validation.

selectionRule: Intersect local and whole-run admissions across both splits, then choose the first cell ordered by low Scoreline payoff, low Afterimage payoff, Ward setup 0/1/2, acquisition 2/4 and Faultline uncommon/rare. Outcome magnitude never breaks a tie.
successRule: At least one cell passes every local and whole-run gate on both independent splits. Freeze the selected minimum for a new independent candidate-specific repertoire and detector protocol; these rows are not final RC acceptance.
stopRule: If no cell passes, publish a bounded negative for the complete known-level scalar family. Do not add a V39 value, reuse these cohorts for another hypothesis or optimise the failed family; continue inside issue #421 with the cheapest structurally different evidence-backed mechanism.
inconclusiveRule: A harness fault, immutable-input mismatch, incomplete CRN rectangle or wall-time exhaustion yields no content conclusion. Repair and preregister a new protocol identity before adding replacement rows. Statistical threshold misses are bounded negatives, not invitations to rerun.
